title: WatchRateChangedPayload
description: watch.rate.changed v1 (OpenVibe.Watch server/provider-rates.js changeEvent(); plan P6, flag WATCH_PROVIDER_RATES off by default): a provider's published price document stated a different value for one model and token class than Watch last observed. It is EVIDENCE, not a rate card: Watch writes no billable price, and a person (never a service or an agent) must approve or reject the change; the decision is dated evidence for OpenVibe.AI's catalog operator. Money is integer nano-USD per million tokens as a decimal string (D1: never a float). Envelope: subject { type: provider-rate, id: <source_key> }, visibility internal, priority important, source and actor service:watch.

source_key.description: The source Watch fetched: the provider's key in its registry (deepinfra, featherless).

provider.description: The provider whose document stated the rate (deepinfra, featherless).

model.description: The model id exactly as the provider's document stated it.

from_nano_usd_per_m.description: The value Watch last observed, as an integer nano-USD per million tokens string; null for a first price.

to_nano_usd_per_m.description: The value the document states now, as an integer nano-USD per million tokens string.

currency.description: The document's currency; USD for both sources today.

region.description: The document's scope; global for both sources today.

effective_date.description: The first day this value was observed (YYYY-MM-DD); an unchanged value keeps its first date.

source_url.description: The official document fetched; never a private or authenticated URL.

approval_required.description: true for a change: it waits for a person's decision.
